_readme: Captured price fixtures for WINDFALL_FIXTURES=1 replay mode.
These stand in for live Duffel and hotel re-query so the pipeline runs
end-to-end, deterministically, with no API keys. Reading them is a read of
a local file, which is squarely inside the penyisihan storage rule; nothing
The live path stays fully functional and is the default. Fixture mode is a
reproducibility measure for judging day, and the UI labels it visibly --
'cached for reliability' must never quietly become 'faked'.
Rung totals are FULL CART totals (flight + hotel), not hotel-only, because
delta_k is measured against the whole cart. The flight component is
identical across every rung by construction: the ladder never touches the
flight, so a Hold Order stays valid.

cart-wf-01.note: Gate closes before the ladder runs; the reprice figure is recorded only so the trace can show the cart was genuinely re-quoted.

cart-wf-02.note: Premium, tau=15%. reprice -2.0%, lateral -8.0% (found but short), tier_down -16.1% clears. The hotel is 63% of this cart, which is why one star down can move it 16 points.

cart-wf-03.note: Comfort, tau=10%. reprice -2.0%, lateral -11.0% clears. Ladder stops before any downgrade is proposed -- the outcome the product is least apologetic about.

cart-wf-04.note: Value, tau=5%. Best rung is -4.2%, short of the bar. Thin inventory on the route, so no rebuild is worth showing; falls through to a different trip.

cart-wf-05.note: Cold start. Ladder runs on the cart-proxy tier (economy + 4-star = Comfort, tau=10%); best rung is -6.0% and nothing clears. No alternative fits either, so the cart is left exactly as it was. This is the 'found something, not worth showing' case.

cart-wf-06.note: Upstream failure path. The classifier completes; the searcher halts.

_timings_note: Captured wall-clock from a recorded live run, replayed in fixture mode. In live mode these are measured per request. Never synthesised from a hash of the cart id -- a duration the UI presents as real must be real.
